positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Systems
positions.description:
Building scalable cloud and distributed systems that support real-world autonomous AI applications.

Working on the reliability, security, and deployment foundations required to operate intelligent systems in dynamic physical environments.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Cloud Infrastructure & Scalability: Designed and maintained scalable cloud infrastructure, ensuring high availability, cost efficiency, and performance.  

CI/CD & Deployment Optimization: Built and optimized CI/CD pipelines to improve deployment efficiency and developer experience.  

Microservices & Auto-scaling: Improved microservices deployments with optimized auto-scaling, resource efficiency, and seamless rollouts.  

Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implemented Terraform and Infrastructure as Code best practices for consistent, repeatable, and version-controlled infrastructure.  

Observability & Monitoring: Enhanced system reliability with monitoring and log aggregation, improving incident response and proactive system health insights.  

Security & Compliance: Strengthened security by integrating automated vulnerability detection and aligning with industry best practices.  

AI & Automation: Leveraged AI-powered tools to optimize workflows, automate processes, and improve development efficiency.  

Identity & Access Management: Streamlined identity and access management, enhancing security and reducing manual intervention.  

Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Mentored engineers on DevOps best practices, automation, and cloud security, fostering a culture of continuous learning.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Accelerated QA & Testing: Enhanced regression testing efficiency through automation tools, improving testing accuracy and scalability.  

Salesforce Integration: Developed automated license generation to streamline end-user request handling and operational workflows.  

Licensing Tools & Utilities: Designed and refined server setup, installation, and debugging tools to support robust server-client communication and trace collection.  

Deployment Optimization: Led cross-functional initiatives to improve release automation and enhance GitLab CI/CD pipelines for faster and more reliable deployments.  

Version Control Migration: Transitioned legacy repositories to Git and GitLab, providing training and improving engineering collaboration.  

Internationalization & Localization: Automated localization workflows and built test suites to ensure high-quality, globally ready software.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Tutored math for the Colton and Fontana school districts. One on one tutoring sessions with K-12 students.
